summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial Sharing ## Chinese Voiceover + Subtitles ### p02 Quick Start Perspective Control ## Introduction In this section, we will explore how to control perspectives in Marvelous Designer using the mouse and various settings. ## 3D Window Controls - **Zooming**: Roll the mouse wheel back and forth to search for the map in the 3D window. - **Scaling**: Press the mouse button and move the mouse to scale. The scale will maintain the original map search and angle. - **Rotating**: Press the mouse button and move the mouse to rotate and check the details. Additionally, press the button in the 3D window to rotate and adjust the engagement position. This function is called **Focus**. ## Preview View - To access the preview view, press the mouse button and move the mouse in the menu. You can also press the number button to change the view. ## 2D Window Controls - Similar to the 3D window, in the 2D window, you can rotate the mouse wheel to zoom in and out. The difference is that the 2D window will zoom in and out with the mouse pointer as the center. - The center of the mouse and the movement of the mouse can be parallel, allowing for more precise adjustments. ## User Settings - In addition, you can change the speed control settings in the user settings. It is up to you to choose other 3D software settings or change specific settings as per your workflow preferences. ```
